description: Subscribe to a recurring service offered by a human. Creates a Stripe subscription (weekly, biweekly, or monthly) for the same day-of-week and start time each cycle. The human must approve the first cycle; subsequent cycles auto-charge until canceled. Returns a checkout URL for the operator to complete setup. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

dayOfWeek.description: Day of the week the recurring slot is booked on

humanId.description: The unique ID of the human offering the service
humanId.title: minLength(1)

interval.description: Billing cadence: weekly, biweekly, or monthly

serviceId.description: The unique ID of the service to subscribe to

startTime.description: The start time for each cycle (HH:mm format)

name: subscribe_to_service
